question_text: A chart is stored as an uncompressed raster image. Outline how its pixel dimensions and colour depth affect its storage requirement.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: More pixels require more encoded pixel values. More bits per pixel allow more colours but increase data per pixel; ignoring headers, size is width×height×bits_per_pixel bits.

marking_points.criterion: Greater bit depth increases per-pixel storage.
Explains colour/detail tradeoff or correct multiplicative relation.
